historical_source_notice.exact_label: PRIVATE / NONCANONICAL / NOT APPROVED FOR PUBLICATION
historical_source_notice.explanation: The notice “PRIVATE / NONCANONICAL / NOT APPROVED FOR PUBLICATION” records the status of the source candidate when it was prepared. It remains part of the preserved author-approved bytes. The work’s current release status is recorded separately in its approved release manifest. A canonical release does not rewrite the original’s provenance.

status_policy.canonical_designation: Effective only upon separate author approval adopting this exact manifest as the governing record.
status_policy.publication: Requires separate author authorization and independently verified publication evidence. This manifest is not a publication receipt.

presentation_boundary.rule: A readable view or any Human Projection is derived, noncanonical, read-only and has no semantic authority over the originals.

authentication.scope: Authenticates the exact manifest bytes when independently verified against the authorized public key; does not establish artistic, ontological or factual truth.

hash_semantics: SHA-256 over exact file bytes without normalization. The manifest and its detached signature are not listed as their own hash inputs.

verification.original_files: Verify complete package-local inventory, byte counts and SHA-256 against files and canonical_components. Reject missing, altered or non-local paths.
verification.authentication: Independently verify the detached signature over the exact manifest bytes with the separately authorized full project-key fingerprint before publication.
